name: tourisme-casamance
description: Site vitrine tourisme Casamance (Sénégal) - Next.js + Strapi + PostgreSQL

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../strapi && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../strapi && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: cd frontend && npm run lint:fix && cd ../strapi && npm run lint:fix
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm run test && cd ../strapi && npm run test
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && rm -rf frontend/.next strapi/.tmp strapi/dist node_modules frontend/node_modules strapi/node_modules
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../strapi && npm install
